Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 89: November 2008
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #89 shipped to subscribers in October 2008 (bearing the cover date of November 2008 for Issue 89). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #89 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, unlockable media, and exclusive previews:

Viva Piñata: Trouble in Paradise (life simulation)
FIFA 09 (sports simulation)
NBA Live 09 (sports simulation)
Fracture (third-person terraforming shooter)
Duke Nukem 3D (Xbox Live Arcade classic FPS port)
Portal: Still Alive (Xbox Live Arcade expanded puzzle-platformer)
Samurai Shodown II (Xbox Live Arcade fighting game)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable Left 4 Dead gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews—including featurettes for Gears of War 2, Fallout 3, and Call of Duty: World at War, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
